Count.description: Value must be >= 0. Value must be a multiple of 2.

list.description: Item count must be >= 1. Item count must be <= 4. Items must be unique.

number.description: Existing numeric rule. Value must be >= -1e+400. Value must be <= 9.99e+999. Value must be > -2. Value must be < 10. Value must be a multiple of 1e-300.

text.description: Length must be >= 2. Length must be <= 8. Value must match pattern "^[A-Z]+\\s?$". Value must use format "custom/value".
